_comment: Hand-verified subjects for cases the model got wrong, keyed by case key.
Highest precedence: these overwrite the model's answer in `classify` and
are written with via='hand:verified' rather than via='llm:...', so the
provenance on the site never claims a model produced them.
Every entry must cite the document it was verified against.

epref:2018/2573.subject: Foreign Affairs
epref:2018/2573.source: TA-8-2018-0069, 'Guidelines on the framework of future EU-UK relations', 14 Mar 2018 (B8-0134/2018, B8-0135/2018). Model said 'Budgets'.
epref:2018/2573.note: OEIL files the Brexit resolutions under Secretariat-General because the Conference of Presidents tabled them, which is why the evidence chain breaks here.

epref:2017/2847.subject: Foreign Affairs
epref:2017/2847.source: TA-8-2017-0361, 'State of play of negotiations with the United Kingdom', 3 Oct 2017 (B8-0538/2017). Model said 'Parliamentary Procedure'.
epref:2017/2847.note: Same Brexit cluster as epref:2018/2573 and epref:2017/2964.
